title: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
summary: Perfect technique for ribeye. Takes longer than fillet despite needing less doneness due to size and fat content that must render. Serves 1.

steps.text: Remove steak from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Pat completely dry with paper towels, season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat pan over medium-high heat with light coat of oil until very hot.
Place steak in pan without moving. Sear 3-4 minutes first side until deep brown crust forms.
Flip steak, sear second side for 3 minutes.
Add butter (and optional thyme/garlic/rosemary) to pan in last 1-2 minutes. Tilt pan and continuously baste steak with foaming butter using spoon.
Remove to plate, rest minimum 5 minutes before cutting. Internal temperature should be 52-55°C for medium-rare.

tips: Pat steak completely dry before seasoning - moisture prevents proper crust formation. Do not move steak once placed in pan. Basting with butter adds richness. Resting redistributes juices. I personally love large steaks (300g) but if you wish to use smaller cuts, you can ask help from the AI assistant to adjust the cooking times accordingly.
